name: late_favorite
description: In the last minutes of a crypto strike market, buy the side the price clearly favors when the model sees an edge, and hold to settlement.

basis.description: Dollars the price feed reads above the settlement index (measure it for your venue and coin)

fair_cap.description: Highest probability the model may claim

hourly_vol.description: Typical one-hour move of the underlying, as a fraction of the price (0.005 = 0.5%). Set it from the market you trade.

min_edge.description: Fair minus ask minus fee required.

min_fair.description: Only buy a side rated at least this likely

window_secs.description: Enter only in this many final seconds.
